brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full + bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full gives enclosed storage volume; cover:0,0,0;full;top closes the top; 6 solid caps close open side faces; meshClash clear.

cover:0,0,0;full;top fitted; setCoverMagnets on:true refused NO_CHANGE stating 'the cover already has its magnets in (a cover has them unless taken out)' — lid is therefore magnet-held shut by the cover's built-in magnets.

finish.summary: Single-cell storage box: full base with full-depth bin inside, closed with a full top cover whose built-in magnets hold it shut. Side faces capped, joints locked, checks clear.
